units.source_text: 这一天她们谈了种种往事，又诵经念佛。

en.t: That day they spoke of all kinds of things from the past, and also chanted sutras and invoked the Buddha.

units.source_text: 这地方居高临下，可以俯瞰来来往往的香客。

en.t: From this high vantage point, they could look down over the pilgrims coming and going.

units.source_text: 面前的河流名叫初濑川。

en.t: The river before them was called the Hatsuse River.

units.source_text: 右近想起了一首古歌：“初濑古川边，双杉相对生。

en.t: Ukon remembered an old poem: "By the old river at Hatsuse, two cedars grow facing one another.

units.source_text: 经年再见时，双杉依旧青。”

en.t: When I see them again after many years, the two cedars are still green."
